name: @aitp/api
description: Runs the Python backend's checks from the pnpm/Turborepo workspace

scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.beat: mkdir -p data && uv run celery -A app.worker.celery_app beat --loglevel=info --schedule=data/celerybeat-schedule
